title: AVP, Federal Sales
description:
Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role
Samsara is building its Federal business, and we're looking for the Sales leader who will build out the team and strategy. As the AVP of Federal Sales, you will be the first and most senior specialized Federal hire, accountable for taking the Samsara Connected Operations Cloud into U.S. federal civilian agencies as part of Phase 1 and defense agencies as part of Phase 2 on a dedicated, FedRAMP-authorized government cloud environment.
Federal agencies run some of the largest vehicle and asset fleets in the world, and they are modernizing how they manage safety, maintenance, sustainability, and mission readiness. Samsara already partners with state and local government agencies across the country, including statewide programs. This role turns that foundation into a durable federal practice.
You will operate as the leader of a dedicated federal practice: you'll design the team, hire it, set the go-to-market strategy, shape our partner and contract-vehicle approach, and own federal bookings. You'll work hand in hand with Product, Security and Compliance, Legal, Marketing, Partnerships, and Revenue Operations to make Samsara easy for federal agencies to buy and trust. This role reports to the Vice President of Public Sector Sales.
This is a remote position open to candidates based on the East Coast (Maine, New Hampshire, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey, Delaware, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, and Florida), with a preference for candidates based in the Washington D.C. metropolitan area. This position requires travel up to 40% of the time.
In this role, you will:
Build and own Samsara's federal go-to-market strategy for civilian agencies, including agency prioritization, territory design, and a multi-year plan that sequences investment against certification milestones and the federal budget cycle - with a plan to expand to defense agencies in the future
Build Samsara's federal route-to-market with Partnerships: distributors and resellers, contract vehicles such as GSA MAS and GWACs, and co-sell relationships with federal systems integrators
Hire, develop, and lead a dedicated federal team of account executives, future business development and capture managers, and solutions engineers, starting with a focused pod and scaling headcount as pipeline and bookings prove out
Own federal pipeline and bookings, with clear leading indicators (agency relationships, qualified opportunities, RFI and proposal activity) in the early stage and full bookings accountability once the authorized product is available to transact
Develop senior relationships with agency fleet, logistics, operations, and CIO/CISO leaders, and represent Samsara at industry days, federal events, and with government affairs partners
Partner with Security and Compliance and Product to translate FedRAMP authorization progress into a clear, accurate customer narrative and to bring agency requirements back into the GovCloud roadmap
Work with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Sales Compensation to design federal-specific pipeline stages, forecasting, quotas, and compensation plans for long-cycle selling
Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, and Contracts on FAR-compliant terms, teaming agreements, and federal ethics requirements, setting a high bar for compliance across the team
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
Minimum requirements for the role:
12+ years of enterprise technology sales experience, with 8+ years selling to U.S. federal government agencies
5+ years leading federal sales teams, including leaders of account executives, as a second-line manager or above
Track record of building or scaling a federal sales practice at a commercial-first SaaS, cloud, or IoT company, including selling through and after FedRAMP authorization
Consistent over-achievement of federal bookings targets, with closed multi-year, seven-figure agency contracts
Hands-on experience with federal acquisition: GSA Schedule and other contract vehicles, distributor and reseller models, and teaming with federal systems integrators
Established relationships with federal civilian agency stakeholders, systems integrators, and the federal partner ecosystem
Experience leading business development and capture for competitive federal procurements, from pre-RFP shaping through proposal and award
Eligibility to obtain a Public Trust position
An ideal candidate also has:
A network that includes experienced federal sellers, capture managers, and solutions engineers who would follow them to a new practice
Experience co-selling with federal systems integrators inside a direct sales organization, including clear account ownership and compensation rules
Familiarity with Shipley or a comparable capture and proposal methodology
Experience designing activity-based or MBO compensation for federal teams before authorized product is available
Working knowledge of FedRAMP, FAR/DFARS, Section 508 accessibility, and Buy American and Trade Agreements Act requirements, and how they show up in deals
Experience with Department of Defense or National Guard fleet programs, as a foundation for future expansion

Hire, develop, and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high-performing team of Engineering Program Managers in the US and Taiwan. Set clear expectations against the TPM/EPM leveling framework and coach each EPM to the next level.
Assign EPMs to programs based on complexity and risk, rebalance as the portfolio shifts, and step in personally to drive the most complex or highest-risk program when needed.
Build the recruiting pipeline, interview loop, and onboarding plan that let the team scale without lowering the bar.
Own the hardware launch system
Own the end-to-end hardware development process from investigation and concept through EVT, DVT, PVT, and GA, and tailor it per program so small programs stay light and large programs stay controlled.
Run the OK2 gate reviews (OK2Concept through OK2FCS) with the VP of Hardware Engineering and Hardware Product Management, and hold the organization to the entry and exit criteria for each gate.
Own the integrated program schedule across HW, FW, SW, reliability, compliance, and supply chain, including the xVT build plan, build allocations, and JDM deliverables through PVT.
Set the standard for program status, risk, and decision communication to executives, and run the weekly hardware project review and steering forums.
Deliver programs
Deliver new hardware programs on schedule, at target cost, and at target quality. Make performance, quality, cost, and time-to-market trade-offs explicit in every status update and gate decision.
Manage JDM and CM partner engagement across the development phases, from RFQ through PVT handoff to Operations Program Management.
Partner with Product Management, Supply Chain, Operations, Quality, Compliance, and Finance so that program goals, business cases, and launch commitments stay aligned as programs evolve.
Identify ways to shorten time to market, improve first-pass build yields, and reduce development cost, and drive those improvements across the portfolio rather than one program at a time.
Make AI how the team works
Use AI tools daily to synthesize program data across Slack, Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, and meeting transcripts; to draft status, risk, and decision documents; and to analyze schedule, cost, and quality data. Validate AI output critically before it reaches stakeholders. You own the result, not the model.
Own adoption and results of AI tooling across the EPM discipline, including the hardware EPM agent that drafts meeting notes, action items, status reports, Confluence updates, and schedule changes for EPM review. Own its roadmap and extend it into risk detection, schedule analysis, and build readiness.
Design, deploy, and iterate AI agents, skills, and automations that remove manual coordination work from program management. Treat AI as a productivity lever before headcount, quantify the hours removed, and reinvest that time into risk management and technical depth.
Set the baseline AI fluency expectation for every EPM on the team, coach to it, and include it in performance and development conversations. Share patterns, prompts, and agent designs across Hardware Engineering and the wider R&D program management community.
Report AI adoption and outcomes (usage, hours saved, cycle-time or quality improvements) to Hardware Engineering leadership on a regular cadence.
Champion Samsara's culture
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's Operating Principles as we scale globally and across new offices.
Minimum requirements for the role
12+ years of experience shipping high-volume hardware programs at scale with ODM and JDM partners overseas, taking products from concept through mass production.
4+ years of experience managing and developing engineering program managers, including hiring, performance management, and coaching across levels.
Proven ownership of a hardware product development process (phase gates, xVT builds, design reviews, PVT handoff) and the judgment to standardize it where it helps and tailor it where it does not.
Strong engineering background with the ability to understand and challenge trade-offs across electrical, mechanical, firmware, reliability, manufacturability, schedule, and cost.
Demonstrated hands-on use of AI tools in your own program management work, and at least one example of an AI workflow, agent, or automation you designed and deployed for a team.
Executive communication skills: concise written and verbal status, risk, and decision communication to VP and C-level stakeholders.
Expertise with program planning tools (Smartsheet or Microsoft Project), Jira and Confluence, and PLM systems for BOM and ECO management.
Ability to travel internationally up to 25% of the time.
BS in a relevant technical field such as EE, ME, or CS, or equivalent experience.
An ideal candidate also has
Worked as an EE, ME, or firmware individual contributor on hardware programs before moving into program management.
Shipped dash cameras, telematics gateways, asset trackers, or other ruggedized, cellular-connected IoT devices with embedded AI/ML.
Built or led an AI agent, Cursor skill, or automation program adopted by a team beyond your own, with measured results.
Led distributed teams across the US and Taiwan or China, and worked directly with Taiwan-based JDM design centers and factories.
Experience bringing firmware and hardware development onto a single integrated schedule, including OTA readiness at launch.
MS in a technical field or an MBA.

One leader across the lifecycle. You own AI for the whole software development lifecycle, for our R&D organization.

title: Robotics Technical Support Specialist
description:
About Standard Bots

Standard Bots is America's largest manufacturer of AI-native industrial robots. Full-stack robots—hardware, software, and AI—all designed and assembled in Glen Cove, New York. The company makes AI-native robots anyone can buy and deploy, with customers ranging from family-owned machine shops to the Fortune 500. Customers include Sunoco, Lockheed Martin, NASA, and the U.S. Army, along with hundreds of manufacturers nationwide. Standard Bots raised a $200 million Series C at a $1 billion valuation from RoboStrategy, General Catalyst, Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund, and Samsung Next.



What you'll do

 - Provide technical support to customers via phone, email, video calls, and ticketing systems — diagnosing and resolving issues with Standard Bots robots

 - Guide customers through troubleshooting processes, configuration adjustments, and best practices for robot deployment and operation

 - Collaborate with engineering, product, and field service teams to escalate complex issues and ensure timely resolution

 - Document technical issues, solutions, and customer interactions in our CRM system (HubSpot or similar)

 - Create and maintain knowledge base articles, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides to improve customer self-service

 - Identify patterns in support requests and surface actionable feedback to product and engineering teams for continuous improvement

 - Own ticket management processes and proactively recommend improvements where inefficiencies exist

 - Meet or exceed support KPIs including response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction

Basic Qualifications:

 - Associate degree or higher in engineering, computer science, robotics, mechatronics, or a related technical field

 - 2+ years of experience in technical support, field service, or a related role in robotics, automation, or technology

 - Proven troubleshooting skills with mechanical, electrical, or software systems

 - Understanding of industrial automation concepts, manufacturing processes, or robotics fundamentals

 - Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences — in writing and in conversation

 - Organized and able to manage multiple open support tickets simultaneously without dropping the ball

 - Are willing to travel occasionally (up to 25%) for training, customer support visits, or team events

Preferred Qualifications:

 - Working understanding of networking, protocols, and device connectivity

 - Experience with collaborative robots (cobots) or industrial robot programming

 - Understanding of machine vision, sensors, or end effectors

 - Understanding of Python, C++, ROS, or similar languages and have experience with Linux/Ubuntu operating systems

Compensation and Benefits:

The salary range for this role is $80,000 to $120,000, depending on experience. title: Senior Quality Inspector (Mechanical)
description:
About Standard Bots

Standard Bots builds AI-native industrial robot arms deployed at manufacturing facilities across the U.S. In June 2026 we closed a $200M Series C at a $1B valuation, led by RoboStrategy with continued backing from General Catalyst and new participation from the Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund and Samsung Next.


About the role

Robots only work if every part is exactly what it claims to be — and that's on you. You'll be the final word on mechanical quality in the QC lab, using GD&T to catch what others miss, leading first article inspections, and making sure the parts going into our robots actually match the drawings they came from.


What you'll do

- Perform GD&T inspection (ASME Y14.5) on mechanical parts and assemblies in the QC lab, catching deviations before they become problems downstream

- Program and operate CMMs and other advanced measurement equipment to verify parts against spec

- Lead First Article Inspections for mechanical parts at launch and after any process change

- Run process audits on production mechanical operations to keep quality consistent at scale

- Mentor Receiving Inspectors on mechanical inspection techniques and GD&T fundamentals

- Keep inspection records and traceability tight and audit-ready for all mechanical work

- Sit on the Material Review Board to help resolve mechanical nonconformances

- Review mechanical drawings for inspectability, flagging GD&T issues to NPI and Engineering before they cause rework

- Support 6S and FOD programs to keep the QC lab area clean, organized, and safe


What you'll bring

- 5+ years of mechanical inspection experience in a QC lab environment

- Strong working knowledge of GD&T per ASME Y14.5

- Hands-on proficiency with measurement equipment — CMM preferred, plus height gauges, optical comparators, and surface plates

- Sharp drawing interpretation skills

- The patience and precision to work through complex measurement tasks without cutting corners


Nice to have

- CMM programming experience with PC-DMIS, Calypso, or similar software

- Experience inspecting industrial robotics or precision mechanical assemblies

title: Account Executive, Amer Platform Grower (Velocity)
description:
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
The Platform Velocity Sales team works with B2B Software Platforms to help them facilitate payments for their customers using our Stripe Connect product. Software Platforms, also known as B2B Indirect, are software platform businesses who serve other businesses. You will work with the next wave of startup platforms already using Stripe.
As a key member of the Stripe Platforms team, you will manage and elevate relationships with a named account list while identifying new growth opportunities and ways Stripe can exceed expectations.
What you'll do
As an Account Executive (Existing Business), you will create partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing software platforms in the world by helping them to understand how Stripe's online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses.
Responsibilities
Directly manage and cultivate a named account list while crafting comprehensive account plans aimed at winning and expanding business with upper middle market and enterprise companies.
Build and sustain key relationships with C-level executives, ensuring the orchestration of appropriate executive touchpoints.
Contribute to the development of our platform partnership strategy by establishing repeatable processes and scalable engagement models.
Develop outbound strategies to create and nurture new business opportunities.
Own the complete sales cycle, from lead generation to closing sales with upper middle market and enterprise clients.
Coordinate and support the implementation of sold platforms and facilitate their effective utilization of Stripe products.
Foster relationships with executive stakeholders at both new and existing clients.
Collaborate with leaders across various functions (such as Engineering, Product, and Finance) to conduct complex product workshops and financial analyses.
Lead and contribute to team initiatives aimed at developing and refining our sales process.
Engage with Product and Engineering teams to shape and drive product strategy.
Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
You are an adept salesperson and relationship manager capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO. You have an in-depth understanding of the buyer journey and can lead a complex, multi-party sale in a highly consultative manner. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding combined with technical knowledge. You are naturally analytical and enjoy digging into business models and helping customers quantify their investment decisions. You get excited about prospecting and are capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish. Finally, you enjoy building — you like to actively participate in the development of our sales process, the articulation of our value proposition, and the creation of key tools and assets.
If you're motivated, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!
Minimum Requirements
At least 5 years of sales or prospecting experience, ideally within a technology company, with a consistent record of top performance.
Proven ability to manage a named account list and develop account plans for upper middle market and enterprise companies.
Experience building and maintaining relationships with C-level executives (CTO, COO, CFO).
Demonstrated ability to own and close a full sales cycle, from prospecting through to contract.
Strong analytical skills with experience helping customers model and quantify business investment decisions.
Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Finance to lead complex product workshops and financial analyses.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Pay and Benefits
The range listed on this page is the role’s annual base salary range. This range may vary depending on the candidate’s location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed on this page will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.
